lines.en: Victor, you should have seen the cathedral last spring. The roof was being repaired, and scaffolding covered the whole dome.
lines.pt: Victor, você devia ter visto a catedral na primavera passada. O telhado estava sendo consertado, e andaimes cobriam toda a cúpula.

lines.en: Really? When I went there, the stonework was being cleaned, so half of the entrance was closed to visitors.
lines.pt: Sério? Quando fui lá, a cantaria estava sendo limpa, então metade da entrada estava fechada aos visitantes.

lines.en: That sounds right. While the crumbling walls were being examined, visitors were still being allowed inside, which surprised me.
lines.pt: Parece certo. Enquanto as paredes em ruínas estavam sendo examinadas, os visitantes ainda eram deixados entrar, o que me surpreendeu.

lines.en: Who was paying for all of it? The funding must have been a problem, because the work lasted almost three years.
lines.pt: Quem estava pagando tudo isso? O financiamento deve ter sido um problema, porque a obra durou quase três anos.

lines.en: A conservator told me that the money was being raised through donations while the repairs were being planned.
lines.pt: Um conservador me contou que o dinheiro estava sendo arrecadado com doações enquanto os reparos estavam sendo planejados.

lines.en: I read that the windows were being restored when the bad weather arrived, so everything was delayed.
lines.pt: Li que as janelas estavam sendo restauradas quando o mau tempo chegou, então tudo atrasou.

lines.en: Right. And even today the south tower is being cleaned by a small team, and old stone is being replaced piece by piece.
lines.pt: Isso. E ainda hoje a torre sul está sendo limpa por uma pequena equipe, e a pedra velha está sendo trocada peça por peça.

lines.en: I would love to watch them work. Is the cathedral being opened to groups this month?
lines.pt: Eu adoraria vê-los trabalhando. A catedral está sendo aberta a grupos neste mês?

lines.en: Yes. A guide told me that new tours are being organised, and the stairs are being checked this week.
lines.pt: Sim. Um guia me disse que novas visitas estão sendo organizadas, e as escadas estão sendo vistoriadas esta semana.

lines.en: Then let us go on Saturday. The building is being lit at night now, and the photos should be wonderful.
lines.pt: Então vamos no sábado. O prédio está sendo iluminado à noite agora, e as fotos devem ficar lindas.

lines.en: Perfect. While the lights were being tested last week, I took some photos from the bridge. I will show you.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Enquanto as luzes estavam sendo testadas na semana passada, tirei fotos da ponte. Vou te mostrar.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo
facts.sub: Ação em curso: The roof was being repaired. The tower is being cleaned. Forma: be + being + particípio. Use by só se o agente importa.

facts.label: Estava sendo
facts.sub: Use was/were being + particípio para uma ação em andamento no passado: The roof was being repaired. O agente quase nunca importa, por isso usamos o passivo.

facts.label: Está sendo
facts.sub: Use is/are being + particípio para o que acontece agora: The tower is being cleaned. Em português, “está sendo limpa”. Não diga is cleaning, que muda o sentido.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was being + participle describes an action in progress in the past.
“The roof is being repaired” means it was finished.
items.why: It means the work is happening now.

items.s: The passive continuous uses a form of be + being + participle.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Was being + participle describes an action in progress in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“The roof is being repaired” means it was finished. → Falso (It means the work is happening now.)
The passive continuous uses a form of be + being + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A cathedral under repair · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey morning beside the River Thames in London. Emma and Lia are standing in front of an old cathedral. Workers in yellow jackets climb the scaffolding. The two friends talk about what has been done here. They want to understand how a building like this is looked after.

“Lia, you should have seen the cathedral last spring. The roof was being repaired, and scaffolding covered the whole dome.” says Emma. “Really? When I went there, the stonework was being cleaned, so half of the entrance was closed to visitors.” says Lia. “That sounds right. While the crumbling walls were being examined, visitors were still being allowed inside, which surprised me.” says Emma.
